001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao;
002
003import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
004import androidx.room.Dao;
005import androidx.room.Delete;
006import androidx.room.Insert;
007import androidx.room.Query;
008import androidx.room.Update;
009import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
010import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Completable;
011import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single;
012import java.time.Instant;
013import java.util.Collection;
014import java.util.List;
015
016/**
017 * Data access object for managing operations on the Pin entity in the database.
018 * Provides methods for inserting, updating, deleting, and querying Pin records.
019 */
020@Dao
021public interface PinDao {
022
023  @Insert
024  Single<Long> insert(Pin pin);
025
026  default Single<Pin> insertAndReturn(Pin pin) {
027    return insert(pin)
028    .map((id) -> {
029      pin.setId(id);
030      return pin;
031    });
032  }
033
034  @Insert
035  Single<List<Long>> insert(Collection<Pin> pins);
036
037  @Insert
038  Single<List<Long>> insert(Pin... pins);
039
040  @Update
041  Completable update(Pin pin);
042
043  @Update
044  Completable update(Collection<Pin> pins);
045
046  @Update
047  Completable update(Pin... pin);
048
049  @Delete
050  Completable delete(Pin pin);
051
052  @Delete
053  Completable delete(Collection<Pin> pins);
054
055  @Delete
056  Completable delete(Pin... pin);
057
058  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin WHERE pin_id = :id")
059  LiveData<Pin> selectById(long id);
060
061  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin WHERE user_id = :userId ORDER BY created_on ASC")
062  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectByCreatedOnAsc(long userId);
063
064  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin ORDER BY created_on DESC")
065  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectByCreatedOnDesc();
066
067  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin WHERE track_id = :trackId ORDER BY created_on ASC")
068  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectByTrackId(long trackId);
069
070  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin WHERE created_on >= :rangeStart AND created_on < :rangeEnd  ORDER BY created_on ASC")
071  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectWhereCreatedOnInRangeByCreatedOnAsc(Instant rangeStart, Instant rangeEnd);
072
073  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin ORDER BY title ASC")
074  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectByTitleAsc();
075
076  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin ORDER BY title DESC")
077  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectByTitleDesc();
078
079  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin WHERE title LIKE :filter ORDER BY title ASC")
080  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectWhereTitleLikeByTitleAsc(String filter);
081
082  @Query("SELECT * FROM pin WHERE user_id = :userId ORDER BY created_on ASC")
083  LiveData<List<Pin>> selectByUserId(long userId);
084
085
086}
